Vocabulary

gossip
talk about other people's private lives

spill the beans
reveal secret information

TRANSCRIPT

Note: This is not a word-for-word transcript.

Neil
Hello. This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Neil.
Beth
And I'm Beth. Neil, can I tell you a secret? Promise you won't spill the beans.
Neil
I promise. Gossip is something most of us enjoy, even if we don't admit it. Today we're talking about why.

Beth
Psychologists say sharing stories about other people helped early humans survive. It built trust in small groups.
Neil
That makes sense. But gossip can also damage friendships when it turns unkind.

Beth
True. Let's recap the vocabulary. Gossip means talking about other people's private lives.
Neil
And if you spill the beans, you reveal a secret. That's all for this programme. Goodbye!
Beth
Bye!
